answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 162063 Country: India Title: Namaz Over Underground Septic Tank Question: My Question is that in our Masjid's premises out side the mosque there is a underground septic tank of masjid’s washroom and wudhu-khana this piece of land is waqf for masjid by my family can we perform salah on this septic tank by building another Farsh (Laying Marble etc). Is it permissible? Kindly reply as soon as possible. Answer ID: 162063 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1144/1069/M=9/1439) The said piece of land which your family endowed for the mosque it became waqf and came out of your ownership. Another floor may be erected on this septic tank and salah may be offered on it but that part shall be deemed to be out of the mosque. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
